about: Inkling-2-Mini (MLX 4-bit: 4-bit affine attention, NVFP4/MXFP8 experts) on mlx-lm's server at a 262,144-token window, one request at a time, thinking on by default. mlx-lm runs Inkling 2 from ml-explore/mlx-lm#2086 (pinned commit). The launcher adds Inkling's response format (reasoning, tool calls) and, through INKLING_FAST, fuses the decode step's small elementwise chains with mx.compile (decode only; prefill is mlx-lm's own code): +15-20% decode on an M4 Max 64 GB against interleaved controls (40.4 vs 33.8/35.2 tok/s, n=6), prefill unchanged. Needles found 3/3 at 102K and 242K tokens; peak footprint 40.4 GiB on the 242K prompt, so one 256K request at a time on 64 GB.
install: python3 -m pip install 'mlx-lm @ git+https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm.git@0c4c99192230f1943dd468d297f0b8a64ae7b7c2' mlx==0.32.4 transformers==5.23.0 huggingface_hub==2.4.0 (macOS on Apple silicon, Python >= 3.10)
